jobs.name: tests_gpu_full_review
jobs.cmd: export PYTHONPATH=.; mkdir -p results && {python} -m pytest -s -p no:warnings -rA tests > results/{name}.txt 2>&1; tail -3 results/{name}.txt

jobs.name: arxiv_holdout_check
jobs.cmd: export PYTHONPATH=.; mkdir -p results && {python} scripts/check_arxiv_holdout.py --out results/arxiv_holdout_overlap.json > results/{name}.txt 2>&1; tail -30 results/{name}.txt
